name: Store product page
summary: Gallery with thumbnails, size and grind choices, one-off or subscription pricing, an add-to-bag button that shows the total, details, reviews, a mobile buy bar and a sold-out state (?state=sold-out).
anatomy: Centred shop nav → breadcrumbs → gallery (60%) | buy box (40%) → details accordion → reviews → footer; sticky buy bar on phones
motion: None on purpose: a product page is a tool for choosing and buying, and the buy box must never move. The gallery is the picture.
